subject: RFI: Encryption & KMS — sample artifact packet and access-log guidance
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridline.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security@gridline.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: RFI: Encryption & KMS artifacts — request for sample proofs

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Gridline's vendor RFI (SIG subset), we need a small packet of sample artifacts to validate encryption controls and key management procedures. Specifically can you provide: 

- A short control crosswalk (map SIG/ISO/SOC2 control IDs to Redwood controls) — 1 page.
- A sample KMS key-rotation proof (anonymized) + accompanying diagram of key hierarchy.
- A 1–2 minute snippet of access logs showing KMS API calls (sanitized for PII).
- Any HSM attestation or third-party KMS vendor summary (if applicable).

Can you also confirm whether providing the raw CloudTrail-style JSON is required, or if a redacted PNG/CSV snippet is sufficient for initial review? We're trying to avoid legal procurement timelines if the samples look good.

Target timeline: can you share samples by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-04)? If not, please propose an ETA and any blockers.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if helpful.

Regards,
Liam
Senior InfoSec Manager — Gridline Financial
liam.oconnor@gridline.com
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridline.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Encryption & KMS artifacts — request for sample proofs

Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can get a compact packet together that covers the asks. Quick answers up front: 

- Crosswalk: yes — we'll provide a one-sheet mapping SIG/ISO/SOC2 control IDs to Redwood's controls and evidence references.
- KMS rotation proof: we can produce a redacted PDF showing rotation events and signed timestamps; we will not share raw key material.
- Access logs: a redacted CloudTrail-style CSV or PNG snippet is fine for initial review. We typically avoid raw JSON dumps unless requested for deep forensics.
- HSM attestation: our hosted platform uses a managed KMS + customer options for Dedicated/Private with HSM integrations; we'll include a short vendor summary and pointer to third-party attestations where applicable.

Proposed delivery: initial packet (crosswalk + sample artifacts) by EOD Wednesday 2026-11-04. If Gridline would like raw logs for downstream teams, call that out and we'll queue an escalation with legal/security for sanitized exports.

I'll assemble the packet with Karthik and Mina. Attaching the control-crosswalk template we're going to populate, and I'll follow up with a Drive link to the full packet.

Attachments: control-crosswalk.xlsx (template)

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Solution Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Encryption & KMS artifacts — internal artifact plan

Vanessa / Mina — plan below for the Gridline packet: 

1) Crosswalk: I'll populate SIG control IDs against Redwood control names and point to evidence artifacts (SOC2 report sections, config snaps). ETA: Tue EOD.
2) KMS rotation proof: Mina — can you pull the rotation audit entries (timestamps + signer/hsm_id) and redact usernames? We should replace account IDs with hashed placeholders. I'll create an explanatory diagram of the key hierarchy (master -> intermediate -> data keys).
3) Access log snippet: we'll export a 2-minute window of CloudTrail-style entries for KMS:GenerateDataKey, KMS:Decrypt, KMS:Encrypt. Redact IPs and user IDs. Prefer CSV snippet + PNG rendering for the packet.
4) HSM/Third-party: I will compile vendor attestation links and short paragraph describing when Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private uses HSMs.

Docs to include in Drive: control-crosswalk.xlsx (populated), kms-keyproof-sample.pdf (redacted rotation proof), access-log-snippet.png.

Flagging a potential blocker: if Gridline requests raw, unredacted logs we need legal signoff. Also, rotation proof may contain UTC timestamps only — convert to local where useful.

I'll draft language for the packet intro so security teams have context.

— Karthik
Senior Applied ML Infrastructure Engineer
From: Aisha Mehta <aisha.mehta@gridline.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridline.com>, security@gridline.com
Date: 2026-11-02T11:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Encryption & KMS artifacts — request for sample proofs

Vanessa — thanks. Couple clarifying Qs from our infra team: 

- For the access-log snippet, can you confirm the CSV column headers you plan to include? We prefer: eventTime,eventName,sourceIPAddress,userIdentity,requestParameters. If any fields are missing after redaction, flag them.
- For the KMS rotation proof, can the PDF include the key alias and rotation timestamp but with key IDs redacted (we still need to see the alias naming pattern)?
- HSM attestation: does Redwood host any keys in an HSM for the hosted plan, or only for Dedicated/Private customers? A short statement will suffice — our procurement will decide risk profile accordingly.

If you can share the Drive link when ready, we'll route to our SRE + procurement. Call not required unless you hit legal blockers.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Security Engineer — Gridline
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com>
To: Aisha Mehta <aisha.mehta@gridline.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gridline.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Encryption & KMS artifacts — sample packet (Drive link + notes)

Aisha / Liam — delivering the initial packet (attached to Drive link below). Summary of what's included and answers to your clarifying Qs: 

Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/GRIDLINE-KMS-RFI-PACKET
DocuSign (for any requested exception): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123-gridline

Packet contents (high level):
- control-crosswalk.xlsx — one-sheet mapping SIG/ISO/SOC2 -> Redwood control names + evidence pointers (SOC2 report sections, console screenshots).
- kms-keyproof-sample.pdf — redacted rotation proof (alias names present; key IDs hashed; timestamps in UTC).
- access-log-snippet.png — 30-line PNG rendering of CSV (columns: eventTime,eventName,sourceIPAddress,userIdentity,requestParameters). CSV available on request; we redacted IPs and userIdentity fields and replaced with hashed placeholders.
- vendor-attestations.txt — short notes on HSM usage: Hosted: cloud-managed KMS (no customer HSM by default); Dedicated/Private: customer-managed KMS/HSM options with integration notes.

Answers: 
- CSV headers: yes — we included the headers you requested in the source CSV. The PNG is a visual rendering; request the CSV if you need machine-parsable.
- Rotation proof includes aliases and timestamps; raw key IDs are redacted per our standard.
- HSMs: Hosted does not use customer HSMs by default. Dedicated/Private customers can bring their own keys/HSM or we can integrate with a supported KMS provider — see vendor-attestations.txt.

If Gridline needs raw JSON logs or additional unredacted artifacts we will file a legal review and provide an ETA after that review.

Please confirm receipt and whether the packet satisfies the SIG subset for now. If you want a 20m sync, we can book a meeting next week.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Solution Engineer — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodai.com

Attachments: kms-keyproof-sample.pdf (redacted), access-log-snippet.png (redacted), control-crosswalk.xlsx (populated)
